integrity: Graph and all index conventions are explicitly defined. The determinant factorization is a symbolic identity and checked from scratch by the attached standalone script. Independent adjacency-based exhaustive enumeration covers n=3,4,5,6; these finite checks corroborate but do not replace the general proof. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the simple strong product P_3 boxtimes C_n with n>=3, not higher-width cylinders or strong tori. The root-sum determines the full polynomial but is not a coefficientwise elementary binomial formula. The finite symbolic matrix determinant identity is exactly reproducible with verify.py; independent external mathematical audit and priority verification have not been performed.
title: Exact domination polynomial and a four-periodic parity law for three-row cylindrical king graphs
